comments:
e13590e9: ;Patch DGJ*1*3 installation script.
;This script is used during the installation of patch DGJ*1*3.
eed3ae0b: ;Entry point for the environment check process.
1a31b8f3: ;Initialize the abort flag to an empty string.
32c48eaa: ;Check if the necessary variables are set, abort if not.
89d39fb1: ;Display a separator line for readability.
c78c7503: ;Inform the user that programming variables are improperly set.
8340ba10: ;Notify the user that the installation has been aborted.
b9ccb90a: ;Notify that the environment check has been successfully completed.
1ce6974d: ;Exit the environment check routine.
a09cd1e0: ;Abort block that sets the abort flag for the installation process.
39b31e2b: ;Set the abort flag to 2 to indicate an aborted installation and then quit.
db702cbf: ;Pre-installation routine entry point.
166f1d2f: ;Set DIK variable to the file and field to be deleted.
9802bf67: ;Execute the deletion command.
abff6835: ;Exit the pre-installation routine.
603c4c4a: ;Post-installation routine entry point.
7ec34810: ;Initialize variables for the post-installation routine.
1aa33882: ;Set DIC variable for lookup in the OPTION file.
f4c11c51: ;Specify the name of the option to be put out of order.
af44f466: ;Find the option, and if it doesn't exist, quit the subroutine.
d7137055: ;Display a separator line for readability in the post-install process.
3214408b: ;Display the message about putting the option out of order.
53a08ba3: ;Set the text to indicate the option is disabled.
e8834ab6: ;Execute the command to disable the option.
8af8f1b8: ;Exit the post-installation routine.
